title: Guest Services Academy Notes on the Engagement Parking Saving for Self-Parking on Guest Folios
content:
Ashbury Rewards members with many elite night credits in the year receive an engagement parking saving on the self-parking of their stays on Guest Folios.

**Rule.** Engagement parking saving: a membership with seventy-five (75) or more elite night credits in the current calendar year adds the seventy-five-night saving percent of 3 percentage points, one with fifty to seventy-four (50 to 74) adds the fifty-night saving percent of 2 percentage points, and one with fewer adds nothing. The points are added into the stay's self-parking saving percent before that percentage is applied to the self-parking charged.

The elite night credits are those shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay, accrued in the current calendar year.

## Questions and answers

**A member has 74 elite night credits this year.** 50 to 74: 2 percentage points.

**A member has exactly 75.** 75 or more: 3 percentage points.

**A member has 50.** At the lower threshold: 2 percentage points.

**A member has 49.** Fewer than 50: nothing is added.

**Do last year's night credits count?** No; only the elite night credits of the current calendar year.

| Elite night credits this calendar year | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 75 or more | 3 |
| 50 to 74 | 2 |
| 49 or fewer | None |
